_comment: The 40-document FINAL sample of the Part 3 dispatch segmentation (seed 31337). Drawn from the dispatch documents of the corpus after the last class fixes (the rebuilt corpus of 3,177 dispatches), labelled by hand BEFORE the segmenter was scored on it, and not used to tune anything: this is the sample the final segmenter had not met. Same field conventions and policy as the earlier samples (or27-dispatch-sample.json, -heldout.json, -fresh.json). after_id is the id the corpus gave the document at drawing time. Drawn from the documents a build produced, so it measures how well those documents are cut and read, not how many true dispatches the build lost.
